name: analysis
help: Explicit agreement chance/design model

name: input
help: Complete input CSV; no silent deletion

name: labels
help: Unique nonblank JSON/YAML/CSV reader-facing labels, including population and measurement

name: format
help: Explicit input arrangement; ICC and Bland-Altman currently require wide

name: confidence-level
help: Prespecified interval confidence level in (0,1); LoA population coverage stays 95%

name: missing
help: Missing ratings are fatal; complete-case deletion is never silent

name: independent-unit
help: Actual independent unit; counts tables explicitly declare aggregate-unit

name: unit-description
help: Explain independence and any deliberately performed upstream aggregation

name: repeated-measures
help: Repeated/clustered measurements are unsupported by the copied independent-unit methods

name: outcome-unit
help: Common measurement unit for continuous methods; dimensionless for categorical coefficients

name: dataset-name
help: Dataset label printed on every figure; does not attest real owner data

name: id-col
help: Stable independent-unit ID column

name: rater-cols
help: Distinct comma-separated rater/method column names in deliberate order

name: rater-col
help: Long-format rater-ID column

name: rating-col
help: Long-format observed category column

name: count-col
help: Counts-table non-negative integer frequency column; every cell including zero is explicit

name: scale
help: Category scale; ordinal order must be declared

name: levels
help: Complete comma-separated ordered categories; never inferred for ordinal data

name: weights
help: Nominal/Fleiss none; ordinal Cohen both retains linear primary and quadratic sensitivity

name: ci-method
help: Cohen analytic or subject bootstrap; Fleiss requires subject bootstrap

name: bootstrap-reps
help: At least 100 subject bootstrap draws; recorded even when analytic was explicitly selected

name: interpretation
help: Descriptive convention, never a universal adequacy threshold

name: paradox-agreement
help: Optional Cohen-kappa warning threshold in [0,1]; original source convention 0.8 is retained when absent; changes warning only

name: paradox-kappa
help: Optional Cohen-kappa warning threshold in [0,1]; original source convention 0.6 is retained when absent; changes warning only

name: paradox-prevalence-index
help: Optional Cohen-kappa warning threshold in [0,1]; original source convention 0.5 is retained when absent; changes warning only

name: paradox-bias-index
help: Optional Cohen-kappa warning threshold in [0,1]; original source convention 0.2 is retained when absent; changes warning only

name: marginal-divergence
help: Optional Cohen-kappa warning threshold in [0,1]; original source convention 0.2 is retained when absent; changes warning only

name: icc-model
help: ICC model explicitly chosen from design, never inferred

name: icc-definition
help: Absolute agreement versus consistency are different estimands

name: icc-unit
help: Single rater or mean of raters; changes the estimand

name: rater-population
help: Random rater population or the fixed raters studied

name: same-raters
help: Whether every independent subject has the same raters

name: icc-fixed-agreement-rationale
help: Why the fixed set itself is the target of absolute agreement

name: adequacy-threshold
help: Optional independently prespecified adequacy threshold in [0,1]

name: adequacy-rationale
help: Source and purpose of an optional prespecified adequacy threshold

name: method-a-col
help: Numeric method A column, in the same declared unit as B

name: method-b-col
help: Numeric method B column, distinct from A

name: difference
help: Signed difference orientation; has no default

name: acceptability-limit-lower
help: Optional prespecified lower acceptable difference, supplied with upper

name: acceptability-limit-upper
help: Optional prespecified upper acceptable difference, supplied with lower

name: acceptability-rationale
help: Concrete source and purpose of prespecified acceptability limits

name: journal
help: OmicStat display preset only

name: study-contract
help: Exact validated StudyContract bytes

name: development-mode
help: Explicit candidate-only execution

name: seed
help: Recorded reproducibility seed for native subject bootstrap

name: outdir
help: New or empty output directory

name: spec
help: Exact resolved-spec replay
